statements.quote: Data Center revenue for the third quarter was a record $51.2 billion, up 66% from a year ago and up 25% sequentially, driven by three platform shifts - accelerated computing, powerful AI models, and agentic applications.
statements.notes: Quarterly figure (Q3 fiscal 2026, quarter ended 2025-10-26), not full-year. The same figure appears in the p01 bullet. p11 gives the components, Data Center compute revenue of $43.0 billion and Networking revenue of $8.2 billion. These are not recorded separately to avoid double counting.
